QUOTE: Compile time (no runtime indirection). In the project's user config, define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO=my_calloc` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO=my_free`. ... When both macros are set, the runtime setter is compiled out.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair and states that the runtime setter is compiled out when the macros are set. That makes the two routes mutually exclusive.
